profile.name: Ndivhuwo Makhavhu
profile.tagline: Turning complex data into clear, actionable insights.
about: I'm Ndivhuwo Makhavhu, a data analyst based in Sandton, South Africa, working across financial markets and lead analytics.

My work starts with raw, scattered information and ends with something a business can act on. I curate data solutions and dashboards that turn that information into decisions — which leads to pursue, what actually converts, and where the value is really sitting. Most recently that's meant modelling how South African SMEs get matched to capital, and isolating the levers that move funding conversion.

I came into analytics from web development, so I tend to build the thing that carries the insight rather than hand over a spreadsheet and hope. Increasingly I'm folding AI into those solutions — not as a bolt-on, but where it makes the analysis sharper and the tools genuinely more useful.

projects.title: SME Rise Capital Matching
projects.summary: Data-driven capital matching model for SMEs.
projects.description: Developed a comprehensive model to analyze SME financial data and pair them with appropriate capital providers. Provided Recommedations on strategies on to optimize conversion rate on SME reciving capital funding.
